scope: Single source receiver m1-natural, complete three-view PAMF with reference response, seeds 2026092701/02/03. Main split excluded. Existing target data and prior results are exposed, so this is development evidence.
question: Does a natural-order first-stage source-only curriculum followed by the fixed Tri signature permutation and the same multi-branch physics-aware SSL improve stability? Original PL and Tri used different ordering from the start. All checkpoint parameters have identical names and shapes; the order is a nonpersistent graph setting, so the fixed permutation is installed for all continuation training and inference. This is a changed training trajectory, not a matched isolation of SSL alone.
method: For each seed load the exact m1-natural scratch E20 from the existing natural-order ordinary PL trajectory, with the same L/U/V data roles, physical IDs, RX/day, model seed, ablation and source contract, no target access and no teacher. Continue E21–E50 on the three-view fixed shuffled Tri graph with the existing source-day multi-branch relations, per-branch U/L gradient guard, and branch-certified weak As simulation. Two arms keep source-day pair masks unfiltered (day_physics) or apply four-of-five source-L branch votes to the relations (branch_certificate); raw accepted pseudo-CE/KL is unchanged in both. This extends Tri SSL while explicitly changing the E1–20 ordering curriculum.
comparisons: same-seed day_physics continuation of original Tri E20
same-seed branch-certified continuation of original Tri E20
evaluation: Freeze all six candidate predictions before independent truth-last scores. Each m1-natural same-packet test: clean and six practical scenes; DURA-LU primary, DURA-L/raw secondary; cross_date separately from the cross_rx/cross_both combined population. Report each seed, scene, TX/RX/day and paired corrections/regressions. No leo_weak or target-driven model selection/reruns.
success: Aim to exceed PL by more than 2 percentage points in clean and every practical DURA-LU scene and exceed original Tri; report all seed/scenario negatives, and do not generalize from this exposed setting.
command: python -m experiments.pamf_physics_tri.publish --curriculum --repo REPO --output UNIQUE_LOCAL_ROOT --context EXISTING_CONTEXT --ssh-config N607_CONFIG
environment: N607 ordinary account, immutable code release and unique output root; matching data/provenance checked; actual-parent no-query smoke spans all six rows.
resources: Per latest user direction, GPU 0–7 with up to four observed or pending processes per GPU including other owners, subject to conservative free-memory reservation for pending workers; never interrupt healthy jobs.
stop_rule: Stop new dispatch upon systemic technical failure, preserve all healthy workers and artifacts, and do not use target results for checkpoint selection or selective reruns.
expected_artifacts: Six true E20 parent, no-query smoke checks
Six E30/E50 fixed continuation sources and actual SSL counters
Six frozen seven-scene predictions followed by independent matched three-seed and subgroup scores
